propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is a single scalar env var that cannot express per-tier model mapping and must be deprecated in favor of per-class configuration slots (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_REVIEWER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_WRITER_MODEL)
the deprecation must register via _scheduled in _deprecations.REGISTRY with remove_in=_MAJOR (v1.0.0), not _permanent, because it is a SUPERSESSION by a different interface rather than a RENAME
within the migration window REBAR_LLM_MODEL must still work, emit a deprecation warning on each read, and map to all three classes for backward compatibility

the warning must be emitted at BOTH env-read sites (config.py:469 and model_classes.py) with provenance checks to avoid false positives from resolved strings, and must fire per-call not once-per-process

operator-facing documentation (CLI help, MCP tool descriptions, module docstrings, and six prose files including README.md) must stop presenting REBAR_LLM_MODEL as the current interface and instead show class configuration with the var marked deprecated
example configs (Anthropic-only, Bedrock-only, mixed-provider, local+fallback) must be added to docs as complete [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] tables operators can paste directly
